text.アートを愉しむギャラリーのようなリビングや音楽を愉しむための部屋など、都心のヴィ: A fine apartment renovation for making the most of life at Hiroo Garden Hills, a vintage block in the middle of the city: a living room like a gallery for enjoying art, a room for listening to music. Walnut flooring and charcoal-grey carpet give a masculine palette, while natural materials such as lime plaster keep the rooms from reading as merely cool. Wall panelling painted pale blue runs through the bedroom, the entrance and the living room, carrying the green and the sky from east to west through the glass.
text.最高品質の原材料のみを使用し、18世紀から受け継がれるペイント技術により一枚一枚: An English paper wallcovering made from the finest raw materials alone, each sheet painted by hand using techniques carried down from the eighteenth century. Natural pigments, no smell, a smooth finish.
